metadata.short_desc: Keeps the notice board, notebook and whispers apart so your bot remembers what belongs where.
metadata.desc: Gives your chatbot a three-layer long-term memory (notice board / notebook / whispers) using indexed Markdown files, no embedding model needed. Includes automatic history, trash, journals, signed board notices, manual tidying and backup/migration. Please read the first part of the README before use!

enable_memory.hint: Injects the memory opening block and gives the chat model memory_read / memory_search to read and memory_write / memory_edit / memory_delete to write the three layers. Memories have three layers: the notice board (visible to every chat, written by admins), the notebook (shared by every group and private chat of this bot), and whispers (only the current conversation). When turned off, saved memories stay on disk; the bot just stops reading and writing them.

recall_max_files.hint: The most memory files attached per turn. Default 5. Each file is capped at 3,000 characters and all of them together at 9,000; anything longer is cut. 0 turns recall off.

recall_full_files.description: Recalled files attached in full per turn
recall_full_files.hint: Each turn, the most relevant few non-identity recalled files are attached in full; the rest are collapsed into a single pointer line to read with memory_read when needed. Identity files (the sender, people mentioned with @, and so on) in the notebook are always attached in full, do not use these slots, and still count against the per-file 3,000-character and 9,000-character total budgets. Set it to at least "Max memories recalled per turn" to attach every recalled file in full. Default 2.

memory_reminder_turns.description: Remind the model to write memory every N turns
memory_reminder_turns.hint: Every this many turns, remind the model in the request to review the recent conversation and write down what is worth keeping long-term. Default 10; 0 turns it off. One extra reminder is added right before AstrBot truncates or compresses the context (at most once per truncation or compression).

history_keep_days.hint: Old versions saved before memories are overwritten or edited are kept this long and then cleaned up; 0 keeps them forever. Each file always keeps at least its 10 most recent versions. Default 90.

trash_keep_days.hint: Deleted memory files stay in the trash this long and are then cleaned up; 0 keeps them forever. The memory page can view, restore, or delete them early. Default 90.

enable_forgetting.hint: When on, memories that have not been recalled or read for a long time drop out of the index and recall so the bot stops carrying them, but the files are kept: they come back automatically when that person shows up again or the bot reads the memory itself, and the memory page's "Forgotten" tab lets you restore or delete them for good. Agreement memories are never forgotten. Off by default; nothing changes while off.

forget_after_days.description: Forget after this many unused days
forget_after_days.hint: A memory that has not been recalled or read for this many days (unused ones count from their last modification) moves to "Forgotten". Only applies while "Enable memory forgetting" is on. Default 90.

memory.refreshFailed: Refresh failed. The page still shows what was loaded earlier

memory.boardSub: Visible in every conversation of every bot; posted by admins
memory.boardSearchHelp: Filters by title, signature and the start of the text; press Enter to search the whole text

memory.boardDetailEmptyHint: Choose a notice on the left to read, renew or edit it, or post a new one.
memory.publishHint: A notice carries its signature and shows up in every conversation of every bot from the next turn. Once it expires it is taken down automatically; the file is kept.
memory.publishFileHint: Leave empty to name it by time (notice-<time>.md). A custom name may only use letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens, and must end with .md
memory.noticeTitleHint: One sentence that says what the notice is, up to 120 characters; it becomes the title in the index and the opening block
memory.noticeBodyHint: Markdown is supported, up to 8000 characters
memory.fieldSignatureHint: Stored in the notice's frontmatter; filled in automatically next time
memory.fieldSignatureLastHint: Filled in with the signature you used last time; you can change it
memory.fieldExpiresHint: The notice expires at the end of that day and then stops appearing in conversations. Leave empty for no expiry
memory.renewCurrentExpired: This notice expired on {date}. Renewing it puts it back at the start of every conversation.
memory.renewHint: Expires at the end of that day; leave empty for no expiry
memory.notebookSub: Shared by every group and private chat of this bot
memory.notebookNoneHint: Once a bot writes its first notebook memory, it shows up here under the bot.
memory.tidyTimeoutHint: How long one consolidation call may take. The default scales with the batch size, from 3 to 10 minutes.
memory.whisperSub: Only this conversation can read and write
memory.whisperListSub: Kept per conversation; group name, nickname and note are all searchable
memory.whisperNoneHint: A conversation shows up here once the bot receives a message in it.
memory.pickConversationHint: Choose a conversation on the left to see its whispers.
memory.remarkHint: Only shown on this page, up to 64 characters; the bot is not told
memory.purgeSessionHint: Moves all whispers of this conversation away and deletes its context stats and registration.
memory.purgeSessionPoint1: The {n} whisper files of this conversation, together with forgotten files, history versions and trash, are moved out of the memory folder as a whole. They can no longer be viewed or restored on this page.
memory.purgeSessionPoint2: The moved folder stays in memories/.trash-scopes/ in the plugin data directory for {days} days and can be fetched back by hand.
memory.purgeSessionPoint2Forever: The moved folder stays in memories/.trash-scopes/ in the plugin data directory indefinitely and can be fetched back by hand.
memory.purgeSessionPoint3: Context stats, the conversation registration and the note are deleted too; the conversation is registered again the next time someone speaks in it.
memory.searchHelp: Filters by file name, description and source; press Enter to search the text
memory.searchEnterHint: Press Enter to search the text
memory.noMemoriesHint: The bot writes down what is worth keeping as it chats. You can also add one by hand with "New".
memory.indexHasIssues: The index has problems to look at
memory.typeHint_person: Someone's profile: how to address them, role, interests. The file name must be user-<platform ID>.md or user-<platform ID>-<topic>.md
memory.typeHint_agreement: Agreements and requests to the bot. In the notebook only admins can write them, and they are never forgotten
memory.typeHint_note: Everything else: things in progress, checklists, plans, material, things heard
memory.typeHint_journal: A running daily log: no index line of its own, never auto-recalled
memory.editorEmptyHint: Pick a memory on the left to view it, or create a new one.
memory.originNone: No source record (written on this page, or an old file)
memory.noFrontmatterNotice: This file has no standard frontmatter (name, description, type). Edit it with the form and save to add it.
memory.expiredNotice: This notice expired on {date} and no longer appears in conversations. You can renew or delete it.
memory.longNotice: This file is long ({reasons}); consider splitting or tidying it.
memory.longNoticePlain: This file is long; consider splitting or tidying it.
memory.danglingNotice: Links in the text point to memories that do not exist: {files}
memory.purgeFileHint: For when someone asks to be forgotten: deletes the file together with its history versions and trash copies, and cannot be undone.
memory.purgePoint1: Deletes the active or forgotten file itself and all of its history versions.
memory.purgePoint2: Deletes every copy of this file in the trash and the original text kept in tidy records, so undoing a tidy will not bring it back.
memory.purgePoint3: The audit log keeps its entries: only file name, time and source, no text.
memory.deletePoint: The file moves to the trash and its line leaves the index; the bot stops seeing it from the next turn.
memory.trashKeep: The trash keeps it for {days} days; you can restore it until then.
memory.trashKeepForever: The trash keeps it indefinitely; you can restore it any time.
memory.forgetPoint: The file moves to "Forgotten": out of the index and out of recall, so the bot cannot see it, but the file is kept.
memory.forgetAutoRestore: It comes back by itself when that person shows up again or the bot reads it; you can also restore it by hand under "Forgotten".
memory.forgetManualRestore: You can restore it any time under "Forgotten".
memory.historyHint: The old content from before every overwrite, edit or delete is kept here for {days} days, with at least the last {n} versions of each file.
memory.historyHintForever: The old content from before every overwrite, edit or delete is kept here indefinitely.
memory.noHistoryHint: After this file is changed for the first time, its old content shows up here.
memory.restoreVersionMessage: Replace the current {file} with the version from {time}.
memory.restoreVersionPoint: The current content is saved to history first, so you can come back to it.
memory.compareHint: Lines with a minus are in the current file but not in this copy; lines with a plus are in this copy but not in the current file.
memory.fieldFileHint: Letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens only, ending in .md. A person's profile is user-<platform ID>.md
memory.fieldFileRenameHint: Changing this renames the file; its history versions move along to the new name
memory.fieldDescriptionHint: One sentence on what this is and when it is useful; it becomes this memory's line in the index
memory.fieldBodyHint: Markdown is supported; use [[file name]] to link to another memory in the same place
memory.fieldRawHint: The raw file including frontmatter, saved exactly as written
memory.fieldRawBoardHint: The raw file including frontmatter. Notices have no type, so a type line is removed; the signature must stay
memory.errFileIndex: MEMORY.md is maintained by the plugin and cannot be used as a memory file
memory.errFileName: Use only letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens, and end with .md
memory.errFileExists: {file} already exists here; choose another file name
memory.errPersonName: A person's file must be named user-<platform ID>.md or user-<platform ID>-<topic>.md (topic: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only)
memory.errPersonType: A profile whose name starts with user- can only have the "Person" type
memory.errPersonBadName: Files starting with user- are person profiles, but this name does not follow the rule: the topic may only use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens
memory.errBodyTooLong: The text can be at most {n} characters
memory.switchToRawMessage: Changes made in the form are not saved yet. Switching to "Raw" discards them.
memory.switchToFormMessage: Changes made in the raw text are not saved yet. Switching to "Form" discards them.
memory.moveHint: Pick a target. Created, updated and source fields stay as they are; the original file goes to the trash.
memory.moveSearch: Search group name, nickname or remark
memory.moveNotebookConsequence: After the move, every group chat and private chat of this bot ({platform}) can read this content.
memory.moveWhisperConsequence: After the move, only this conversation can read this content.
memory.moveToTrashPoint: The original file goes to the trash, where you can restore it.
memory.moveWillWrite: {n} memories will be written to the target.
memory.movedRenamed: Moved; both copies kept, the new file is {renamed}
memory.moveSourceKept: Written to the target, but the original file could not be moved to the trash; delete it manually.
memory.conflictTitle: The target already has a file with this name
memory.conflictMessage: The target already has {file}. What should happen?
memory.conflictKeepPoint: Keep both: the moved copy becomes {name} and the target's file stays.
memory.conflictKeepPointPlain: Keep both: the moved copy gets a numbered name and the target's file stays.
memory.conflictOverwritePoint: Overwrite: the target's old version goes into history first and can be restored there.
memory.conflictOverwriteForgottenPoint: Overwrite: the target's forgotten copy of this name goes to the trash first and can be restored there.
memory.renameNotice: Rename: {from} → {to}. The history versions of the old name move along.
memory.diffFormHint: Below are the changes to the form fields and the text; created time, updated time and source are maintained by the plugin.
memory.diffRawHint: Below are the changes to the raw text, which is saved exactly as written.
memory.discardMessage: What you are editing has not been saved. If you leave, the changes are lost.
memory.indexTruncated: The index is longer than what the model receives, so the part past the limit is cut off. Merge related memories or delete outdated ones.
memory.indexMissing: {n} memory files are missing from the index, so the model does not know they exist:
memory.indexDangling: {n} index lines point to files that no longer exist:
memory.indexHealthy: The index matches the memory files.
memory.indexReadonlyHint: The index is a cache: the plugin keeps it in sync with the memory files and their descriptions. It is read-only here; to change a line, edit that memory file's description, or rebuild from files.
memory.indexEmpty: The index is empty; rebuild it from the memory files.
memory.rebuildTitle: Rebuild the index from the files?
memory.rebuildPoint1: Existing lines get a refreshed description and hand-written headings and groups are kept; lines pointing to missing files are removed and missing files are added at the end.
memory.rebuildPoint2: The index is only a cache; rebuilding does not change any memory file.
memory.trashHint: Deleted memories are kept here first.
memory.noTrashHint: When a memory is deleted, its old file stays here for a while.
memory.trash_discard_forgotten: Forgotten copy replaced by a new write
memory.deleteTrashPoint1: Permanently deletes this copy in the trash; it cannot be undone.
memory.deleteTrashPoint2: The active file and its history versions are not affected.
memory.restoreOverwritePoint: {file} already exists: its current content is saved to history first and then overwritten by this copy from the trash.
memory.forgottenHint: Memories that have not been recalled or read for {days} days (agreements excepted) are moved here: out of the index and out of recall, files kept. They come back by themselves when that person shows up again or the bot reads them.
memory.forgottenOffHint: Memory forgetting is turned off. These files were forgotten earlier; nothing more is forgotten or restored automatically, but you can restore or delete them here.
memory.noForgottenHint: Memories that go unused for more than {days} days are moved here automatically.
memory.deleteForgottenPoint: The file moves to the trash and no longer shows under "Forgotten".
memory.tidyPickHint: Only tidying uses this chat model; the model used for chatting is unchanged.
memory.tidyPickEmpty: No enabled chat models in AstrBot's model providers, so tidying is unavailable.
memory.tidyPickUnavailable: The previously selected tidy model was removed or disabled. Choose another one.
memory.taskProgress: Batch {done} / {total} done ({files} files in this scope)
memory.taskQueuedHint: Other tidy tasks are running first; at most 2 run at once, and this one starts automatically.
memory.taskCancelledNotice: Tidying was cancelled; completed batches remain in the plan.
memory.taskInterruptedNotice: Tidying was interrupted when the plugin restarted; completed batches remain in the plan and you can tidy again.
memory.taskMissing: The tidy task state is gone. Tidy again.
memory.taskCancelConfirmPoint: Completed batches stay in the plan; you can tidy again afterwards.
memory.discardTaskPlan: Starting a new tidy will discard the unapplied changes in the current plan. Continue?
memory.autoFixCount: {n} of these automatically repair dangling links and can be unticked separately.
memory.applyPointAutoFix: Automatic repairs only touch dangling links: links that match an existing file point to it; the rest lose their brackets.
memory.needsSplitHint: {n} files are each over the budget for one tidy and must be split first
memory.consolidateHint: Ask the selected tidy model to review every memory in "{label}" in batches: merge duplicates, fix outdated facts, normalize the format.
memory.consolidatePoint1: You get a plan first; nothing is written until you tick what to apply and confirm.
memory.consolidatePoint2: Tidying runs in the background in batches, so you can leave the page; only this scope is tidied and nothing moves between layers.
memory.consolidateNothingHint: The model thinks these memories are already in good shape.
memory.consolidateSkipped: {n} files were skipped because their results did not pass validation.
memory.consolidateDoneNotice: The plan was applied. You can undo it in the tidy history below.
memory.planSummary: {n} changes in the plan, all ticked by default
memory.applyPointBackup: The original text before every rewrite or delete is saved to history and the trash.
memory.applyPointDelete: Deleted files also leave the index; the bot stops seeing them from the next turn.
memory.applyPointUndo: The tidy is recorded in the tidy history and the last 5 can be undone; files changed after a tidy are left alone when undoing.
memory.historyEmptyHint: Every plan you apply is recorded here; the last {n} can be undone.
memory.undoPoint1: Deleted memories are written back, rewritten ones get their original text back, and new ones are removed.
memory.undoPoint2: Files that were changed or deleted after the tidy are left alone; the result lists each one.
memory.undoPoint3: The content from before the undo is kept in the history versions too.
memory.consolidateAllHint: Queue one background tidy task for every scope with memories (at most 2 at a time), then tick and apply all plans together.
memory.consolidateAllNone: There are no memories to tidy yet
memory.consolidateAllRunningHint: One tidy task per scope ({n} total); at most 2 run at once and the rest queue. You can leave this page; they keep running.
memory.consolidateAllReview: {n} places came back with a plan; tick what you want and apply everything in one go.
memory.consolidateAllNothing: None of the places needs tidying.
memory.consolidateOneHint: Pick one place and review it on its own.

memory.contextPickHint: Choose a conversation on the left to see how its latest request was composed.
memory.contextReadonlyNotice: This panel is read-only. Truncating and compacting the context is handled by AstrBot's own context settings; this plugin does not change the conversation history.
memory.userIdentifierNotice: AstrBot's user identification is on: this plugin also labels the sender, so the model will see the label twice. You can turn off AstrBot's user identification and let this plugin handle it.
memory.diskHint: No new request in this conversation since the plugin started, so this is the last saved record
memory.noEstimateHint: Once this conversation sends its next message, the composition of the request shows up here.
memory.partNote_plugin: Notice board, index and profiles; sent with this turn's message, not saved to history
memory.partNote_prompt: The user's message this turn (including images)

memory.lastActualSub: Input tokens the provider reported in the latest reply
memory.turnLimitSub: AstrBot truncates once the limit is reached
memory.noSummary: AstrBot has not compacted this conversation yet.
memory.noSummaryHint: Once the context goes past 82% of the window, AstrBot compacts older history into a summary; the latest one is shown here.

memory.manageTidyHint: Let the model merge duplicates and fix outdated content
memory.manageMaintHint: Get back what was deleted or forgotten
memory.welcomeHint: The notice board is read in every conversation, the notebook is each bot's own memory, and whispers belong to that one conversation only.

memory.importHint: Choose a JSON backup exported earlier; you preview it first and import afterwards.
memory.badBackup: This file is not a valid memory backup
memory.policy: When a file with the same name exists
memory.policyHint: What to do when the target already has a file with the same name
memory.importPreviewHint: The numbers are a dry run with the current conflict setting; tick the places to import.
memory.importPointReplace: Overwrites {n} existing files; the old content is saved to history first and can be restored.
memory.migrateScopeHint: Copy or move the memories of one place to another, for example from an old conversation to a new one.
memory.errSameScope: The source and the target are the same place; pick another place as the target
memory.targetNewSession: A new whispers conversation (enter its ID)
memory.targetPlatformNotebook: The notebook of a platform ID (enter the platform ID)
memory.targetPlatformHint: The bot's platform ID in AstrBot; it cannot contain a colon
memory.modeHint: Moving puts the files at the source into the trash after they have been written to the target

memory.migratePointMove: Move: files written to the target are removed from the source (into its trash).
memory.migratePointCopy: Copy: the files at the source stay as they are.

memory.migratePointWhisperVisible: After the move, only the target conversation can read this content.
memory.migrateSkipped: {n} conversations have no complete conversation ID and were skipped

memory.platformPointItems: Affects {n} places (the notebook and the whispers of each conversation).
memory.platformPointMove: Move: emptied old conversation folders and registrations are removed.
